LanguageData.Gun_Mauser_C96_RWP.label: Mauser C96
LanguageData.Gun_Mauser_C96_RWP.description: The Mauser C96 is a semi-automatic pistol with a distinctive boxy design and a wooden stock option, doubling as a holster. Known for its high fire rate and respectable range, this weapon is effective in mid-range combat, providing a balance between power and speed. Originally developed in the late 19th century, it remains a reliable sidearm for skilled shooters.
